What's inside

Today

  • Rate your mood from 1 to 10 with one click – it's saved right away.
  • Add medications one by one, or a whole set with one click.
  • Write down thoughts as soon as they come to mind.

Calendar

  • Switch between week and month views.
  • Open any day to add or change its mood, medications and thoughts.

Statistics

  • Pick a period from a week to a year, or your own dates, and compare it with the previous one.
  • Mood chart, rating histogram, color breakdown, median and your longest streak of good days.

Notes

  • Keep notes alongside your thoughts.
  • Find any entry with search (Ctrl+K).

Privacy

Your diary never leaves your computer

What you write about your mood and your medications is about your health. That's why MoodTracker keeps it with you only – its author has no access to it.

Read the privacy policy →
  • No account, no sign-in
  • No cloud – works without the internet
  • No ads, analytics or tracking

Frequently asked questions

How much does MoodTracker cost?

You buy MoodTracker once in the Microsoft Store – there's no subscription. You can try it for free first. The Store shows the current price in your currency.

Do I need an account?

No. Install the app and start right away – there's nothing to sign up for.

Where is my diary stored?

Only on your computer, in the MoodTracker folder of your Windows user folder. The app doesn't send it anywhere, and its author can't see it. The diary stays there when you uninstall the app, so reinstalling brings your entries back – and you can delete it any time in Settings.

Does it work offline?

Yes. You need the internet only to install and update the app from the Microsoft Store.

Is MoodTracker a medical app?

No. It's a personal diary, not a medical device, and it doesn't give medical advice. You can show your statistics to your doctor or therapist – always talk to your doctor about your treatment.

Which versions of Windows does it run on?

Windows 11 and Windows 10, version 1809 or newer.

Which languages is it available in?

English, Polish, German, Spanish, Portuguese and French. You can change the language in Settings.
